hero.title: Run your church's life, all in one place
hero.subtitle: Shephr brings together your ministry's goals, giving, pastoral care and songbooks — from the member to the international secretariat.
hero.note: Activation is done with our support — write to us to get started.

features.title: Everything your ministry needs
features.subtitle: Modules you can turn on à la carte, designed for every level of responsibility.

goals.title: Goals
goals.desc: Declare and track commitments at every level of the hierarchy, with automatic totals.

donations.title: Giving
donations.desc: Every member records their gifts; leaders view, filter and export the contributions within their scope.

memberCare.title: Member Care
memberCare.desc: Keep track of each person's spiritual journey and make sure leaders stay accountable.

songbooks.title: Songbooks
songbooks.desc: Access hymn books and setlists, built in and available to everyone.

hierarchy.title: Multi-level organisation
hierarchy.desc: From the local centre to the continent: structure, per-module roles and scoped delegation.

reports.title: Reports & exports
reports.desc: Dashboards, maps, trends over time and CSV/PDF exports for oversight and consolidation.

pricing.title: Simple pricing, at your scale
pricing.subtitle: The essential modules are free. Advanced modules are paid à la carte, priced fairly for your church's size.
pricing.freeDesc: Goal tracking and hymn books are always on, at no cost, for every ministry.

donations.name: Giving
donations.desc: Record and oversee giving across your whole scope. Price based on church size.

memberCare.name: Member Care
memberCare.desc: Tracking records, spiritual statuses and accountability. Can be enabled independently from giving.

factors.size: Your church's size (tiers based on member count)
factors.cmci: A mission discount for CMCI churches
factors.bundle: A decreasing rate when you enable several modules

pricing.quoteNote: Large organisations or specific needs? We'll prepare a tailored quote.

contact.title: Activate your Shephr space
contact.desc: Shephr is rolled out with support: no self-service sign-up. Contact us and we'll set up your ministry, create your first access and enable the modules you need.

footer.tagline: The management platform for your ministry.

hierarchy.introChain: Your reporting chain: your leaders up to the root, and your assembly.
hierarchy.emptyHint: No leader or assembly in your scope yet.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.overview: {{date}} · Here is an overview of generosity in your ministry.
dashboard.noDataYetText: Recorded donations will appear here as soon as they are entered in the mobile app.

donations.title: Donations
donations.onPage: <0>{{count}}</0> donations on this page · <1>{{amount}}</1> · {{total}} in total
donations.noMatchText: Widen the period or remove a filter.
donations.physicalDeclaredText: Cash given during a service. Entry is locked 24h after creation.

exports.title: Exports
exports.scopeSub: Filter the donations to include in the CSV file.
exports.chooseSub: The file is generated in CSV format (UTF-8), ready for Excel.
exports.columnsInfo: Columns: Date, Member, Assembly, Category, Amount, Currency, Note. Donations are limited to your visibility scope.
exports.presetMonthDesc: All donations declared since the 1st of the current month.
exports.presetLastMonthDesc: The previous calendar month, from the 1st to the last day.

ministry.title: My ministry
ministry.intro: The ministry you belong to. Its management (creation, subscriptions) is handled by the back office.
ministry.notAttached: Your account is not attached to any ministry.

zones.title: Regions
zones.noCountryHint: No country in your scope (reserved for coordinators).
zones.intro: Subdivisions of a country. A region groups cities. Reserved for country coordinators.
zones.newSub: Attach the region to a country in your scope.

localities.title: Cities
localities.noZoneHint: No region in your scope to create a city in.
localities.intro: Cities / regions of a region. A city groups assemblies (centers and assemblies).
localities.newSub: Attach the city to a region in your scope.

units.title: Assemblies
units.noLocalityHint: No city in your scope to create a assembly in.
units.intro: Centers and assemblies of a city. Members join a assembly via its code.
units.newSub: Attach the assembly to a city in your scope.

users.title: Members
users.intro: Leaders and members within your scope. Invitations are shared by link; the roles you can grant are limited to those strictly below yours.
users.managedUnitsHint: A leader can manage several assemblies.
users.zoneFaithHint: Their visibility comes from their subtree; the region is used to declare their pledges.
users.supervisorHint: The person this account reports to (org chart).
users.shareLink: Share this link with the invited person.
users.inviteSub: Role, supervisor and scope within your organization.
users.activationCodeHint: To share with the invitee to activate from the mobile app.
users.manageSub: Promote / supervisor / attach / (de)activate within your scope.
users.coordinatedCountriesHint: The secretariat will act as Goals coordinator over these countries (read + country faith).
users.deleteWarning: Permanent deletion from the database. Blocked if a region/assembly the person leads would be left without any other leader (reassign first), or if data is linked.
users.cityAttachmentHint: The leader manages every house assembly of their city.

memberCare.title: Member care
memberCare.noUnitAttached: No assembly is attached to your account. Ask an administrator to attach you to your assembly (role "Assembly leader" + assembly) so you can create records.

goals.title: Goals
goals.noActiveGoalText: No Five-Year Goal is active at the moment. Contact your coordinator.
goals.notAttachedText: Your account is not attached to any scope for the Goals module (assembly, region or country). Contact your supervisor.
goals.pledgesSubmitted: Pledges submitted — amounts locked, the current status remains editable.
goals.submitModalSub: After submission, pledges are permanently locked (single act). Only the current status will remain editable.
goals.submitFailed: Unable to submit, please try again.
goals.deleteProgressConfirm: Do you really want to delete this declaration?
goals.pledgeEditableSub: The pledge remains editable until submission.
goals.zeroMeansNoPledge: Entering 0 means “no pledge” for this category.
goals.progressModalSub: Declare where your assembly stands: the figure entered replaces the previous declaration — it is not added to it. Editable until the year's deadline.
goals.editFailed: Edit failed (deadline passed? contact the secretariat).
goals.myPerimeterIntro: Your downstream hierarchy (your assemblies and those of your subordinates).
goals.myPerimeterFaithRule: Retained objective = MAX(sum of your subtree, your pledge).
goals.removeFaithSubtree: Are you sure you want to remove this pledge? The retained objective will revert to the sum of your subtree.
goals.removeFaithAggregate: Are you sure you want to remove this pledge? The retained objective will revert to the total of the sub-levels.
goals.aggregateRule: Retained objective = MAX(total of sub-levels, pledge) — a pledge below the total is not applied.
goals.faithAbove: You pledge by faith to exceed the total by {{value}}.
goals.faithBelowOrEqual: Your pledge is less than or equal to the total — it will not be applied (MAX rule).
goals.attachLeaderTooltip: Attach a LEADER to this assembly (Goals module) to be able to follow up.
goals.reminderModalSub: The reminder will appear in-app for the assembly leader (no email). At most one reminder per assembly per 24h.

goals.reminderAlreadySent: A reminder has already been sent to this assembly less than 24h ago.
goals.reminderNoLeader: This assembly has no leader attached to the Goals module.
goals.reminderAlreadySubmitted: This assembly has already submitted its pledges.
goals.unitPledgesSub: Pledge details for the assembly for {{year}} (read-only).
goals.noEvolution: No payment recorded for this year — no trend to display yet.

goals.unitUnlocked: Assembly unlocked — it can complete and resubmit.
